QUOTE: Callbacks | Pointers are valid only during the call. Do not re-enter the API from a callback. Exceptions must not escape. Python must hold a reference to the `CFUNCTYPE` object. | `streams.py` keeps `_observers`, `hooks.py` keeps `_HookEntry.trampoline`, `hooks.py` catches all exceptions.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says hooks.py catches all exceptions, but never states that a failed hook is treated as a pass-through, which this item requires.
